lastCompletedStory.title: Extract shared subcommand arg-parse helper in index.ts

nextStoryContext: US-002 extracted parseSubcommandArgs (help/-h detection, unknown-option rejection, too-many-arguments rejection, single-positional capture) and rewired parseIssueArgs (free-text fallthrough only), parsePlanArgs, and parseSpecArgs to use it. index.ts grew from 2019 to 2049 lines (no file-size budget entry for index.ts, so no ceiling concern). All previously byte-identical printError message strings are unchanged; only the control-flow duplication was removed. Re-measured jscpd on src+scripts after this story: 3.44% duplicated lines (80 clones), well under the current threshold of 6 in .jscpd.json. US-003 (lower the jscpd threshold to 4) should re-measure fresh right before editing .jscpd.json -- 3.44% comfortably clears a threshold of 4, so US-003 likely needs no further dedup work, just the config change plus a check that check:all (which runs jscpd with reporters:[threshold]) still exits ok at the new value.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal TS refactor of index.ts arg-parsing functions; no new external API surface, no library calls added or changed.
